evidence: The chemical composition, crystalline phase, and surface morphology of the films were studied using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and atomic force microscopy. The film thickness was measured through an EOPTICS SE-100A spectroscopic ellipsometer using Cauchy optical model, and the result was calibrated by a Hitachi S-4800 scanning electron microscope (SEM). The surface morphologies of the films were studied using a Bruker Multimode 8 atomic force microscopy (AFM). The composition and crystalline phase of film were analyzed using a Thermo ESCALAB 250Xi X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and a Bruker D8 X-ray diffraction (XRD).
